snippet.title: The Dark Curiosity - Announcement Trailer
snippet.description:
First-person psychological sci-fi horror set on an abandoned space station. Left alone, you explore and piece together what happened. Something is moving in the dark, and the closer you get to the truth, the closer it gets to you.

Wishlist now on Steam: https://store.steampowered.com/app/4237540?utm_source=youtube
